_comment: CMC's second flavour-synergy pair (round 2 J19): the Tannic tag (Old Growth Bark, carried by Herb Paste) against vanilla Earthy. Like the Savoury pair, it only does anything because one side is a mod tag. Five of the cuts Season with Herb Paste accepts already taste Earthy as well as Savoury (cooked, boiled and dried meat, and cooked and boiled minced meat), so seasoning one of those now makes two good pairings instead of one.
